verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video and image generation platform that ships Luma Agents for multi-step workflows, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to connect external tool servers to Luma or its agents. The axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
